verdict.rationale: Community evidence says Unreal is free to use until a game earns more than $1,000,000, and the license page lists source-code access and all platforms and features. However, the same evidence shows royalties apply above that threshold, and a studio reports Unreal would have cost them $150k, so the 'no royalties' claim does not hold. Source access is also EULA/account-gated rather than permissively licensed. Missing for 10: royalty-free terms at all revenue levels, a permissive (non-EULA-gated) license, first-party documentation of the royalty and fee terms, and evidence on per-install fees.

support.subject: As a studio lead, the license is permissive with no royalties or per-install fees — I keep what my game earns

citations.quote: Only way to pay to use Unreal Engine is to earn more than 1,000,000 usd which for most people means everything is completely free.
